domestic_evidence: Company website vardhman.com (fetched) states: "Vardhman is India's largest vertically integrated textile manufacturer with multiple production facilities across India" and "The vertical contributing close to one-third of Group's turnover, Fabrics business is the growth engine of Vardhman Textiles", plus "Yarns ... manufacturing capacity of 670 metric tons per day" and "Acrylic Staple Fibre and Tow" capacity "22,000 tons per annum". Domestic supply is evidenced by large in-India manufacturing capacity across yarns/fabrics/garments/acrylic fibre/threads/special steels divisions. Specific GST turnover band and GeM/CPPP contract values were NOT retrieved (search engine returned connection refused; annual-report page vardhman.com/investors/annual-reports returned HTTP 404) — recorded as null, not invented.
note: Legal entity VARDHMAN TEXTILES LIMITED is a listed, operating company (Ludhiana, Punjab) — not liquidated or bankrupt, so no rejection ground. The input name is a concatenation of many related group entities (Vardhman Yarns & Threads Ltd, Mahavir Spinning Mills Ltd — the former name of Vardhman Textiles, Vardhman Special Steels Ltd, Anant Spinning Mills) — these are separate legal entities; shipment records were verified only for VARDHMAN TEXTILES LIMITED / VARDHMAN TEXTILES LTD. Declared HS codes 520513/520514/520526/520528 (cotton yarn, not exceeding 14/43/52/68 metric number, single) match the observed shipment HS codes 52051310, 52051210, 52052310 — HS is consistent, no correction needed. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) is WRONG: actual industry is textiles (cotton yarn, fabrics, garments, acrylic fibre) plus special steels — flag for correction, but per Rule 3 this is not a rejection ground. Export shipments are factual (customs records with date, destination, HS and B/L), not website claims. Domestic supply confirmed by actual manufacturing footprint; GST turnover figure remains null pending a public source.
